integrity: The cubed generalized rectangular quotient reduces exactly to a semialgebraic rational supremum. Its unique global maximizer is certified by sign-case reductions, exact derivative elimination, Sturm isolation, subresultants, boundary and escape analysis. The symbolic calculations were independently reproduced. No Lean proof or external expert attestation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact mu_3 only for the real two-dimensional ell_3 plane. Not an evaluation of mu_3 on arbitrary-dimensional ell_3 or mu_p for general p.
title: Exact cubic rectangular constant of the real \(\ell_3^2\) plane
